Name: Additional Farm Cave
Author: tikamin557
Description:
It works like a greenhouse.
Also, forest fairies bring foraging items daily.
Random production of stone, copper ore, or geodes.
(There is also an optional file that varies the ore produced depending on the mining level.)

[color=#ffff00]Version 4.0[/color] added an area further inside.
You can activate Casks in this location.
You can also obtain 4 Casks from the treasure chest, so if you come here before upgrading your house, you'll be able to use Casks a little earlier.
Additionally, enabling Minecart in Modconfig settings will display Minecart on the map, and you can use it in the same way as in the vanilla game once you meet the requirements for using Minecart.

[color=#00ffff]Access Unlock Conditions[/color]
[spoiler][size=4][color=#f4f4f4]・ [/color][color=#ff0000]1st Area[/color][/size]
Demetrius friendship level is 2 or higher.
Robin friendship level is 3 or higher.
Already watched the Demetrius Mushrooms or Bats event.
If you meet all of these criteria, you will receive an email from Robin.
Opening that email will unlock you to additional areas.

[size=4][color=#f4f4f4]・[/color][/size][color=#00ff00][size=4] 2nd Area[/size][/color]
You have visited the first area at least once.
Shipped 5 bottles of either wine or juice.
Once the two items above are fulfilled, a scene event will occur when you enter the Farm between 6:00 AM and 4:00 PM.
Afterward, another scene event will occur when you enter the 1st area, allowing you to enter the 2nd area.[/spoiler]
